name: Take A Breather
description:
At the start of your turn, you may skip your turn and forfeit reactions for 1 round. At the start of your next turn, if you are not Helpless, regain BODY Endurance.

You may use this ability only at the start of your turn, and only a number of times per rest equal to half your BODY score.

improvements.name: Brace Yourself
improvements.description: When you use this ability, you get +2 Defense until the start of your next turn.
